James and Mary Ford, eds.  Every Day in the Year.  1902.

November 4

Eugene Field

By Marion F. Ham (1867–1956)

(Died November 4, 1895)
B
UT
 yesterday he was, and lo! to-day
Upon his lips there is not any breath
To tell me how he fared along the way;
And yet, methinks, beside his pulseless clay
I kneel and listen till I hear him say,
“I’ll sing more sweetly for the sleep of death.”
